name: Agent Apps
author: vladkarok
description: Installed and newest version of the AI desktop apps behind Omarchy's Install > AI menu, and of the agent CLIs mise manages, with one-click updates through Omarchy's recipe, the vendor's own package or mise.

barWidget.description: Shows when a vendor has released a newer version of an installed AI app or agent CLI, and updates it in a terminal through Omarchy's recipe, the vendor's Arch package or mise when you press Update.

schema.label: Notify on new versions
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a vendor publishes a version newer than the installed one.

schema.label: Show mise tools
schema.description: List the agent CLIs mise has installed (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode...) after the desktop apps.

schema.label: Hide icon until an update
schema.description: Show the bar icon only when an installable update exists. IPC open and toggle still open the panel.
